operations.name: Leo Stark

expected.charges: Federal prosecution under the Espionage Act of 1917 and/or the Sedition Act of 1918.

updates.sentence: Five years imposed. Original Labor Defender February1927 printedpage29 lists Leo Stark among Folsom prisoners receiving Christmas support; DailyWorkerDecember7,1929 describes him as released. These sources do not establish the actual release day or month. The former twelve-month total was unsupported and conflicts with the recorded1923admission and later prisoner roster; no replacement total is inferred. Sources: https://www.marxists.org/history/usa/pubs/labordefender/1927/v02n02-feb-1927-ORIG-LD.pdf#page=15 ; https://www.marxists.org/history/usa/pubs/dailyworker/1929/1929-nat/v06-n235-NAT-dec-07-1929-DW-Q.pdf
